engine: SQLite STRICT ANY (in-memory native SQLite driver)
case: grouped AVG() result storage classes through typed CSV re-import
contract: Grouped AVG(value) over STRICT ANY returns REAL for every non-NULL group, including integer, real, numeric text and mixed integer/real inputs; an all-NULL group returns SQL NULL.
Nonnumeric text and BLOB inputs follow SQLite AVG coercion and yield REAL 0.0; native typeof() verifies the result class.
A group containing 9223372036854775807 and 1 produces a REAL average without SUM's integer-overflow error.
Typed CSV export/import restores every computed result and REAL/NULL storage class into STRICT ANY, verified by native typeof() and exact values.

native_contract_group.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app sqlite_ -- --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other computed-expression shapes, additional consumer formats, spreadsheet-app re-import and installed editing remain open.
